discussion_comments.comment_body: 500kB is already too big for a piece of context. The whole point of this check is to not let it grow past that.
The agent should load the resources it needs as defined in its YAML section.  This list likely should be empty.  Otherwise Q will try and load all of these files defined here into context.
Aha! This explains my over context limit warnings in testing. I assumed it was token limits on my q account. I'll update this.
The agents are still working and I am no longer getting the token limits. Thanks @unimonkey1994 for that catch!!!
